A Reuters/Ipsos poll showed Democrats up 6 points, 41 percent to 35 percent. It surveyed 1,215 adults nationwide from August 21 to 24, 2026 and had a margin of error of ±3 percentage points.

Meanwhile, another survey from Verasight and Strength in Numbers gave Democrats a 6-point generic ballot lead, 49 percent to 43 percent. It surveyed 1,514 adults from August 14 to 19, 2026 and had a margin of error of ±2.6 percentage points.

## Democrats Close Polling Gap in Red States [...] The latest generic ballot tests show that Democrats are currently enjoying modest leads over Republicans with fewer than 70 days until the midterms.
